user_query: My company wants to offer a selection of games to our customers. Can you provide a list of on-sale games and upcoming games that include the word 'mount' and 'assassin'? Additionally, include the prices of the on-sale games and the release dates of the upcoming games.

TaskList.description: Query the database for on-sale games that include the word 'mount' and 'assassin'.
Retrieve the prices for the on-sale games retrieved in step 1.
Query the database for upcoming games that include the word 'mount' and 'assassin'.
Fetch the release dates for the upcoming games retrieved in step 3.
